notes: `καί` → *even* is an intensifying particle aligned under rule 65; no `οὕτως` and no comparative stands, so rules 82 and 100 are not in question and the bare-*even* gloss is the right one.
`κύριος` is a predicate noun with an expressed `ἐστιν`, so rules 53 and 63 do not move anything; `τοῦ` before `ἀνθρώπου` is `unrepresented` and the case preposition stays with the noun under rule 21.
